title: ttconv converts a hand-written three-cue SRT to WebVTT and TTML
summary: Three predeclared SRT cues (one two-line, one italic) convert to WebVTT and TTML with matching cue count, millisecond timings, text and line breaks; TTML is well-formed in the TTML namespace; WebVTT back to SRT keeps timings. No IMSC profile check.
